summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Xinyuan Real Estate Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, updating the SEC on its delayed annual report (Form 20-F) for fiscal year 2025. After a prior extension under Rule 12b-25 until May 15, 2026, the company states it still cannot file on time because management needs more time to compile information and finalize consolidated financial statements, and its auditor requires additional time to complete audit testing. The filing is a routine late-filing notice, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, prices, or restructuring activities are mentioned. Watch for potential exchange non-compliance or regulatory follow-up.
